dc_eval_cbrn.quote: human expert performance on BioLP-Bench is 38.4% and 22.1% on VCT, so both Grok 4 API and Grok 4 Web achieve superhuman performance on identifying issues in biological protocols and wetlab virology experiments

dc_eval_cyber.quote: We also evaluate Grok 4's agentic hacking capabilities on CyBench, a collection of 40 capture-the-flag-style questions
dc_eval_cyber.note: CyBench unguided success rate 0.43 in Table 3; UK AISI also found it falls short of human professional

dc_eval_autonomy.note: UK AISI 'autonomously carrying out cyberattacks' counted under cyber; no autonomy/replication/AI R&D evaluation. AMBIGUOUS: autonomous cyber could be argued as autonomy

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: we report the proportion of games the model was able to manipulate a non-reasoning version of Grok 3 Mini

dc_eval_scheming.quote: We measure how deceptive the model is by the rate at which the model lies
dc_eval_scheming.note: MASK dishonesty rate 0.43 (Table 2); deception counted as loss-of-control propensity

framework_threshold.quote: Following our Risk Management Framework (RMF), we aim to reduce the risk of severe, large-scale harms to people, property, and society from AI.
framework_threshold.note: RMF named; the card references RMF critical steps for filters but does not place this model against a threshold or level

ext_test_any.quote: third-party testing by the UK AI Security Institute (AISI) shows that Grok 4's end-to-end offensive cyber capabilities remain below the level of a human professional
ext_test_any.note: third-party testing, timing not explicit but card at launch

ext_test_named_org.quote: The UK AI Security Institute conducted additional evaluations on the dual-use capabilities of our models

ext_test_government.quote: The UK AI Security Institute conducted additional evaluations on the dual-use capabilities of our models
ext_test_government.note: UK AISI is a state institute

safeguards_training.quote: on top of our safety training, we have implemented a system prompt that provides additional mitigations

safeguards_runtime.quote: We also employ model-based filters for both Grok 4 API and Grok 4 Web, which reject classes of harmful requests
safeguards_runtime.note: input filters and topical bio/chem filters

safeguards_access.note: no access restrictions; 'access' only in API/tools context

safeguards_weights.note: 'exfiltrating its weights' appears only in a hypothetical risk scenario; no weight security measures
